observation: Both enum implementations perform cleanup only inside the public abortTransactions(Context) call. PROBING iterates recovered prefixes/subtasks/checkpoint ids and invokes context.getTransactionAborter().abortTransaction(transactionalId); LISTING obtains open transactions from the supplied Context and invokes the same aborter for selected ids. The file defines no timer, thread, scheduler, callback registration, lifecycle hook, or other autonomous invocation path. Its own documentation describes cleanup in relation to restart loops and later successful checkpoints, not an internal background trigger.
